texts.1d84f546b662a85f27eb89eca93ffd814feb7395:
let earthquake  = flip 0.0001 in
let burglary  = flip 0.001 in
let alarm  = earthquake || burglary in
let phoneWorking  = if earthquake then flip 0.7 else flip 0.99 in
let maryWakes  = if alarm then
    (if earthquake then flip 0.8 else flip 0.6)
    else flip 0.2 in
let called  = (maryWakes && phoneWorking) in
let tmp = observe called in
burglary
texts.1e96b78e5a568531e38e7b75a67f2ae403611bfb:
:- use_module(library(pita)).
:- pita.
:- begin_lpad.
earthquake:0.0001.
burglary:0.001.
alarm :- earthquake.
alarm :- burglary.
phoneworking_then:0.7.
phoneworking_else:0.99.
phoneworking :- earthquake, phoneworking_then.
phoneworking :- \+earthquake, phoneworking_else.
marywakes_then_then:0.8.
marywakes_then_else:0.6.
marywakes_then :- earthquake, marywakes_then_then.
marywakes_then :- \+earthquake, marywakes_then_else.
marywakes_else:0.2.
marywakes :- alarm, marywakes_then.
marywakes :- \+alarm, marywakes_else.
called :- marywakes, phoneworking.
obs :- called.
:- end_lpad.
main :-
    forall((Q = burglary), (prob(Q, (obs), P), format("~q:\t~w~n", [Q, P]))).
texts.275300457f41a886e4e913001fcd07d9942f1ae0:
fun mystery() {
    let aliceDunnit  = flip 0.3 in
    let withGun = if aliceDunnit then flip 0.03 else flip 0.8 in
    (aliceDunnit, withGun)
}

fun gunFoundAtScene(gunFound: bool) {
    let res = mystery() in
    let aliceDunnit = fst res in
    let withGun = snd res in
    let obs = if withGun then gunFound else !gunFound in
    let tmp = observe obs in
    aliceDunnit
}

gunFoundAtScene(true)
texts.2e124ce42ba469c75519a230b366c3eed260eca3:
:- use_module(library(pita)).
:- pita.
:- begin_lpad.
firstcoin:0.5.
secondcoin:0.5.
bothheads :- firstcoin, secondcoin.
obs :- \+bothheads.
:- end_lpad.
main :-
    forall((Q = firstcoin), (prob(Q, (obs), P), format("~q:\t~w~n", [Q, P]))).
